events.text: Kick-off! Kelty Hearts vs Stirling Albion is underway at New Central Park.

events.detail: a close-range finish after good link-up play in midfield
events.text: GOAL! Blair Henderson opens the scoring for Kelty Hearts, finishing off good link-up play in midfield. 1-0.
Stirling have a sniff at the other end but Danny Handling's effort is well off target.
Yellow card for Craig Midgley (Stirling Albion) after a late challenge.
Kelty searching for a second goal but Blair Henderson's free kick strikes the wall.

events.detail: a header from a corner, his second of the afternoon
events.text: GOAL! Henderson grabs his second of the afternoon, heading home from a corner. 2-0 Kelty Hearts.
Substitution for Stirling Albion: Marc Laird replaces Shaun McKenzie.

events.detail: a clinical finish on the counter-attack
events.text: GOAL! Marcus Godinho makes it 3-0 with a clinical finish on the counter-attack.
Substitution for Kelty Hearts: Craig Barr comes on for John Pelosi.
Yellow card for Craig Barr (Kelty Hearts), booked for a foul just after coming on.
GOAL! Danny Handling pulls one back for Stirling Albion with a free kick from 25 yards. 3-1.
FULL TIME: Kelty Hearts 3-1 Stirling Albion. A dominant home win, with Blair Henderson bagging a brace.
